title: tc-project-card
description: A project summary with a segmented progress ring that unfolds into its subtasks, people and status.

tasks.description: Subtasks – one ring segment and one row each

status.description: The chosen status id – unset is the first option

members.description: The people on the project – avatars in the head that filter the subtasks to theirs

actionLabel.description: A button on the tray of the open card (Clean: in its last row); it fires tc-action

trigger.description: "hover" opens under the pointer (taps and the keyboard still toggle), "click" only on click

open.description: Whether the card is unfolded, showing the subtasks, the people filter and the tray

assignee.description: Name of a member – shows their avatar on the row and powers the people filter

tone.description: Color of the tag – also picks its icon: violet or gray = not started, amber = in progress, blue = in review, green = done, red = blocked

avatar.description: Image URL – initials on a soft color when left out
